dict.string: Replyline uses the Mac microphone to transcribe customer conversations, including iPhone calls on speakerphone.
Replyline captures meeting audio from this Mac for on-device transcription. Audio is not sent off the Mac.
macOS requires ScreenCaptureKit access to capture meeting audio. Replyline processes audio only and does not record or save screen video.
Replyline transcribes English conversation audio on this Mac to draft a reply.
